metadata.name: lever__interview_enhanced
metadata.comment: Table in which each row is a unique interview-feedback combo. Interviews without feedback appear here as well.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: Indicates the source of the record when unioning functionality is applied. This field will be empty if unioning is not used.

canceled_at.name: canceled_at
canceled_at.comment: Timestamp of when the interview was canceled.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the interview was created.

creator_user_id.name: creator_user_id
creator_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who created the interview in lever.

occurred_at.name: occurred_at
occurred_at.comment: Date + time at which the interview was set to occur.

duration_minutes.name: duration_minutes
duration_minutes.comment: Interview duration in minutes, minimum value is 1.

feedback_reminder_frequency.name: feedback_reminder_frequency
feedback_reminder_frequency.comment: Frequency of feedback reminders (i.e. once, daily, frequently, none). Defaults to 'frequently' which is every 6 hours.

location.name: location
location.comment: Interview location. Usually the name of a booked conference room but can also be a  phone number to call.

opportunity_id.name: opportunity_id
opportunity_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the OPPORTUNITY being interviewed for.

panel_id.name: panel_id
panel_id.comment: Unique id of the PANEL this interview belongs to.

opportunity_stage_id.name: opportunity_stage_id
opportunity_stage_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the STAGE that the candidate was in at the time  the interview was scheduled.

timezone.name: timezone
timezone.comment: Name of timezone in which interview was scheduled to occur.

feedback_form_id.name: feedback_form_id
feedback_form_id.comment: Unique id of the feedback form.

feedback_completer_user_id.name: feedback_completer_user_id
feedback_completer_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who completed the feedback.

feedback_completed_at.name: feedback_completed_at
feedback_completed_at.comment: Timestamp of when the feedback form was completed.

feedback_form_instructions.name: feedback_form_instructions
feedback_form_instructions.comment: Guidelines given for how give a feedback score.

score_system_value.name: score_system_value
score_system_value.comment: Overall rating (1-4 scale) to the candidate.

feedback_form_title.name: feedback_form_title
feedback_form_title.comment: Form title. This can be edited in Feedback and Form Settings.

interviewer_user_id.name: interviewer_user_id
interviewer_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER that interviewed the candidate.

feedback_completer_name.name: feedback_completer_name
feedback_completer_name.comment: Full name of the user who completed the feedback form.

interview_coordinator_name.name: interview_coordinator_name
interview_coordinator_name.comment: Full name of the user who created the interviewer in Lever.

ended_at.name: ended_at
ended_at.comment: Timestamp of when the interview was scheduled to end.

opportunity_owner_name.name: opportunity_owner_name
opportunity_owner_name.comment: Full name of the user who owns the opportunity in Lever.

referrer_name.name: referrer_name
referrer_name.comment: Full name of the user who referred the candidate for this opportunity.

hiring_manager_name.name: hiring_manager_name
hiring_manager_name.comment: Full name of the hiring manager of role for which the opportunity applied.

interviewer_is_hiring_manager.name: interviewer_is_hiring_manager
interviewer_is_hiring_manager.comment: Boolean that is true if the interviewer is also the hiring manager of this position.

interviewee_name.name: interviewee_name
interviewee_name.comment: Full name of the interviewee candidate.

interviewee_origin.name: interviewee_origin
interviewee_origin.comment: The way in which the interviewed opportunity was added to lever. Includes 'agency', 'applied', 'internal', 'referred', 'sourced', and 'university'.

days_between_opp_created_and_interview.name: days_between_opp_created_and_interview
days_between_opp_created_and_interview.comment: Number of days that have passed between the creation of this opportunity and the beginning of this interview.

has_advanced_since_interview.name: has_advanced_since_interview
has_advanced_since_interview.comment: Boolean that is true if the opportunity advanced to another stage after this interview ended.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: lever__opportunity_enhanced
metadata.comment: Table of unique opportunities.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: Indicates the source of the record when unioning functionality is applied. This field will be empty if unioning is not used.

archived_at.name: archived_at
archived_at.comment: Timestamp of when the opportunity was archived.

archived_reason_id.name: archived_reason_id
archived_reason_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ARCHIVE_REASON for which the opportunity was archived.

contact_id.name: contact_id
contact_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the CONTACT info of the candidate applying in this opportunity.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the opportunity was created (ie when the candidate clicked "apply" on your company website).

is_data_protection_contact_allowed.name: is_data_protection_contact_allowed
is_data_protection_contact_allowed.comment: Boolean that is true if relevant data policy regulations allow for contacting  this opportunity's candidate.

data_protection_contact_expires_at.name: data_protection_contact_expires_at
data_protection_contact_expires_at.comment: Timestamp of when this permission/data policy expires.

is_data_protection_store_allowed.name: is_data_protection_store_allowed
is_data_protection_store_allowed.comment: Boolean that is true if relevant data policy regulations allow for storing  this opportunity record.

data_protection_store_expires_at.name: data_protection_store_expires_at
data_protection_store_expires_at.comment: Timestamp of when this permission/data policy expires.

contact_headline.name: contact_headline
contact_headline.comment: Contact headline, typically a list of previous companies where the contact has worked or  schools that the contact has attended.

is_anonymized.name: is_anonymized
is_anonymized.comment: Boolean that is true if the opportunity has been anonymized (therefore fully anonymizing  the contact and removing their *personal* information).

last_advanced_at.name: last_advanced_at
last_advanced_at.comment: Timestamp of when the candidate advanced to their current stage in the hiring pipeline.

last_interaction_at.name: last_interaction_at
last_interaction_at.comment: Timestamp of when the Opportunity profile was last interacted with. See interactions [here](https://help.lever.co/hc/en-us/articles/205697619).

contact_location.name: contact_location
contact_location.comment: Current contact location of the candidate.

origin.name: origin
origin.comment: The way in which the opportunity was added to lever. Includes 'agency', 'applied', 'internal', 'referred', 'sourced', and 'university'.

owner_user_id.name: owner_user_id
owner_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the id of the USER who owns this opportunity.

snoozed_until.name: snoozed_until
snoozed_until.comment: Timestamp of when the current snooze period of this opportunity ends (if snoozed).

stage_id.name: stage_id
stage_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ID of the current stage of the opportunity.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: Timestamp of when the opportunity was last updated in lever.

comments.name: comments
comments.comment: Any additional comments from the candidate included in the job application.

company.name: company
company.comment: The candidate's current company or organization.

posting_hiring_manager_user_id.name: posting_hiring_manager_user_id
posting_hiring_manager_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the id of the USER who is the job posting's hiring manager, at the time  the application was submitted.

posting_id.name: posting_id
posting_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the job POSTING for which the candidate applied.

posting_owner_user_id.name: posting_owner_user_id
posting_owner_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the id of the USER who owns this posting at the time the candidate applied.

referrer_user_id.name: referrer_user_id
referrer_user_id.comment: The user ID of the candidate's referrer.

requisition_id.name: requisition_id
requisition_id.comment: If the application was archived as hired against a requisition, a foreign key referencing the id of the REQUISITION against which the application was hired.

application_type.name: application_type
application_type.comment: Type of the application. An application can be of type referral, user, or posting. Applications of type  referral are created when a user refers a candidate for a job posting. Applications have type user when they  are applied manually to a posting in Lever. Applications have type posting when a candidate applies to a job  posting through your company's jobs page.

opportunity_owner_name.name: opportunity_owner_name
opportunity_owner_name.comment: Full name of the user who owns the opportunity in Lever.

referrer_name.name: referrer_name
referrer_name.comment: Full name of the user who referred the candidate for this opportunity.

hiring_manager_name.name: hiring_manager_name
hiring_manager_name.comment: Full name of the hiring manager of role for which the opportunity applied.

sources.name: sources
sources.comment: Aggregated list of the channels through which this opportunity was sourced.

phones.name: phones
phones.comment: Aggregated list of the contact's phone numbers (with phone types).

emails.name: emails
emails.comment: Aggregated list of email addresses associated with this contact.

linkedin_link.name: linkedin_link
linkedin_link.comment: Contact URL that contains 'linkedin.com' in it.

github_link.name: github_link
github_link.comment: Contact URL that contains 'github.com' in it.

current_stage.name: current_stage
current_stage.comment: The stage that the opportunity is currently at in the pipeline.

tags.name: tags
tags.comment: Aggregated coma-separated list of the tags associated with this opportunity.

archive_reason.name: archive_reason
archive_reason.comment: Reason given for archiving this opportunity.

job_title.name: job_title
job_title.comment: Title of the job posting role.Title of the job posting role.

job_commitment.name: job_commitment
job_commitment.comment: Tag for job position work type (e.g. Full-time, Part-time, Internship).

job_department.name: job_department
job_department.comment: Tag for the department to which the job posting's team belongs, if present.

job_level.name: job_level
job_level.comment: Tag for job posting level (e.g. Senior, Junior). Note - this has been deprecated by Lever  but is currently maintained for backward compatibility.

job_team.name: job_team
job_team.comment: Tag for the team to which the job posting belongs (a sub-category of department).

current_state_of_job_posting.name: current_state_of_job_posting
current_state_of_job_posting.comment: Current status of the posting, which may include 'published', 'internal' (called 'unlisted' in the UI), 'closed', 'draft', 'pending' (awaiting approval), and 'rejected'.

opp_created_n_days_after_first_app.name: opp_created_n_days_after_first_app
opp_created_n_days_after_first_app.comment: How many days this opportunity was created after the first application was sent to this posting.

has_offer.name: has_offer
has_offer.comment: Boolean that is true if the opportunity has been extended an offer.

current_offer_status.name: current_offer_status
current_offer_status.comment: A string describing the current status of the offer. Can include:  draft - the offer is still under construction approval-sent - the offer needs approval approved - the offer has been approved sent - the offer has been sent through Lever sent-manually - the offer has been sent to the candidate outside of Lever opened - the candidate has opened the offer denied - the candidate denied the offer signed - the candidate signed the offer

count_interviews.name: count_interviews
count_interviews.comment: The number of interviews that have been scheduled for this opportunity.

count_interviewers.name: count_interviewers
count_interviewers.comment: Count of how many internal users the opportunity has spoken to via interview.

latest_interview_scheduled_at.name: latest_interview_scheduled_at
latest_interview_scheduled_at.comment: Timestamp of when the opportunity's most recent (or perhaps future) interview was scheduled for.

has_interviewed_w_hiring_manager.name: has_interviewed_w_hiring_manager
has_interviewed_w_hiring_manager.comment: Boolean that is true if the opportunity has interviewed with the hiring manager.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

stage_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the STAGE that the opportunity was changed to.

stage_index_in_pipeline.name: stage_index_in_pipeline
stage_index_in_pipeline.comment: The index of the stage in the pipeline at the time the stage change occurred.

job_team.name: job_team

application_type.comment: Type of the application. An application can be of type referral, user, or posting. application_sources.name: application_sources
application_sources.comment: Aggregated list of the channels through which this opportunity was sourced.

hiring_manager_name.name: hiring_manager_name
hiring_manager_name.comment: Full name of the hiring manager of role for which the opportunity applied.

opportunity_owner_name.name: opportunity_owner_name
opportunity_owner_name.comment: Full name of the user who owns the opportunity in Lever.

content_description.name: content_description

creator_user_id.name: creator_user_id

job_title.name: job_title

count_posting_applications.name: count_posting_applications
count_posting_applications.comment: Count of how many applications were submitted through the posting (including via an agency).

count_manual_user_applications.name: count_manual_user_applications
count_manual_user_applications.comment: Count of how many applications have been manually submitted by internal users.

count_opportunities.name: count_opportunities
count_opportunities.comment: Count of how many opportunities applied to this posting.

count_open_opportunities.name: count_open_opportunities
count_open_opportunities.comment: Count of how many currently open opprtunities applied to this posting.

count_interviews.name: count_interviews
count_interviews.comment: Count of the number of interviews conducted for this posting.

count_interviewees.name: count_interviewees
count_interviewees.comment: Count of opportunities interviewed for this posting.

count_requisitions.name: count_requisitions
count_requisitions.comment: Number of requisitions associated with this posting.

has_requisition.comment: Boolean that is true if the posting has a requisition.

posting_hiring_manager_name.name: posting_hiring_manager_name

metadata.comment: Table capturing requisitions, if enabled.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: Indicates the source of the record when unioning functionality is applied. This field will be empty if unioning is not used.

is_backfill.name: is_backfill
is_backfill.comment: Boolean that is true if the requisition represents a backfill or new headcount.  If unspecified, defaults to false.

compensation_band_currency.name: compensation_band_currency
compensation_band_currency.comment: The ISO currency code associated with the requisition's compensation band.

compensation_band_interval.name: compensation_band_interval
compensation_band_interval.comment: The string representing the interval of payment for the compensation band.

compensation_band_max.name: compensation_band_max
compensation_band_max.comment: The high bound for the compensation band.

compensation_band_min.name: compensation_band_min
compensation_band_min.comment: The low bound for the compensation band.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the requisition was first created.

creator_user_id.name: creator_user_id
creator_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who created the requisition.

employment_status.name: employment_status
employment_status.comment: The work type of the requisition ('full-time', 'part-time', 'intern', 'contractor', or 'temp-worker').

headcount_hired.name: headcount_hired
headcount_hired.comment: The number of filled seats / openings on the requisition, or the string, 'unlimited'.

headcount_infinite.name: headcount_infinite
headcount_infinite.comment: Indicates if the headcount for the job requisition is unlimited, allowing for an unrestricted number of hires.

headcount_total_allotted.name: headcount_total_allotted
headcount_total_allotted.comment: Total headcount allotted for this requisition.

hiring_manager_user_id.name: hiring_manager_user_id
hiring_manager_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who is the hiring manager for this requisition.

internal_notes.name: internal_notes
internal_notes.comment: Free form text for notes and meta-data about the requisition, visible to anyone who can see the requisition in Lever.

job_location.name: job_location
job_location.comment: The location associated with the requisition.

job_title.name: job_title
job_title.comment: The human-readable name for the requisition.

owner_user_id.name: owner_user_id
owner_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who owns the requisition.

status.name: status
status.comment: The status of the requisition. Can be 'open', 'onHold', 'closed', or 'draft'.

job_team.name: job_team
job_team.comment: The team associated with the requisition

creator_name.name: creator_name
creator_name.comment: Full name of the user who created the requisition.

requisition_owner_name.name: requisition_owner_name
requisition_owner_name.comment: Full user name of the user who owns the requisition.

hiring_manager_name.name: hiring_manager_name
hiring_manager_name.comment: Full user name of the requisition's hiring manager.

count_postings.name: count_postings
count_postings.comment: Number of postings associated with this requisition.

has_posting.name: has_posting
has_posting.comment: Boolean that is true if the requisition has a posting.

count_offers.name: count_offers
count_offers.comment: Total count of extended offers associated with this requisition. Note - includes offers regardless of their status.

has_offer.name: has_offer
has_offer.comment: Boolean that is true if the requisition has any offer associated with it.
